# Approved commit author and committer identities for this repository.
#
# The gate in test/identity-audit.test.ts fails closed on any author or
# committer email outside this list, and on any newly added absolute home path.
#
# Unlike the older repositories in this fleet, this list carries no personal
# authoring address. pm-ado was created with a clean history, so nothing in it
# requires one, and the smallest list that admits every identity which actually
# appears is the right one. Adding an address here should be a deliberate act,
# not an inheritance from whichever repository this was scaffolded from.
